assessment.applicability_basis: Article 14(4)(e) is a Chapter III, Section 2 human-oversight requirement for high-risk AI systems. Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 amended Article 113(c): those Chapter III sections apply from 2 December 2027 for systems classified as high-risk under Article 6(2)/Annex III and 2 August 2028 for systems classified under Article 6(1)/Annex I. The preserved occurrence date/window (2026-07-07 through 2026-07-13) is before the earliest application date. Article 14(4)(e) therefore does not apply to this historical occurrence; this temporal disposition does not determine later system compliance or other legal duties. The taxonomy mapping generated a candidate only and does not make the requirement retroactive.
